notes.title: Patch Notes EA_v0.632 - Old and New cards updated
notes.content:
Greetings, Aspiring Dark Mages!

This patch is a spicy one—while it includes a few minor tweaks, it also brings some serious updates to the Keen-Eye Tribe deck (yes, again!) and the long-neglected Zombie Lord deck. Oh, and good riddance to a pretty useless card—I've replaced it with something far more exciting!

Let’s dive into the state of the game...

[b]⚖️ GAME BALANCE ⚖️[/b]
- Heroic Souls will now be collected when time runs out, as long as they were harvested and en route to the Dark Tower.
- Cold mechanics during the Day: Cold now drops faster during an Icestorm. Previously, players lost 5 Cold every 5 TUs. With this update, you now lose 1 extra Cold per Icestorm level:
[list]
[*] If Cold ≥ 40: lose 6 Cold every 5 TUs
[*] If Cold ≥ 60: lose 7 Cold every 5 TUs
[*] If Cold ≥ 80: lose 8 Cold every 5 TUs
[/list]

[b]🃏 CARDS BALANCE 🃏[/b]
- [b]Burning Shard[/b] has been removed! I'm beginning to phase out elemental cards (waiting for a chance to shine again in teh future!), and this is the first to go. But don’t worry—a new card rises in its place:
- [b]Library Rat[/b] (NEW): The Rats welcome a powerful new ally—a Rat Mage! He shuffles every card from your graveyard back into your deck and applies POISON to each Villager per card shuffled. Time his appearance wisely for massive poison stacks!
- [b]Keen-Eye Tribe[/b] (starter deck): Once again updated to better synergize with the theme of managing a "mild" Icestorm.
- [b]Zombie Lord[/b] (starter deck): While the basic deck remains untouched, all Upgraded cards have received major enhancements:
[list]
[*] Gangrenous Zombies will keep crawling toward the Village even after being defeated.
[*] Zombie Twins now react with grief (and fury!) when one sibling is slain.
[*] Revolting Returns has a chance to raise an extra Crawling Zombie.
[/list]
- [b]Titan on Attack[/b]: Upon death, he now splits into two parts—upper body and lower legs—each continuing the fight for the glory of the Dark Mage!
- Dear Dead Friend: Its Demise effect has been softened slightly. Upon defeat, it now spawns a Weeping Soul, which slowly reduces the Rage value unless killed.
-Deranged Miner & Hewers: These gold-crazed diggers now have the ROAMING ability, wandering the battlefield in search of Iceshards to smash into gold.
 
[b]🐛 BUGS 🐛[/b]
- Nothing major, just some typo corrections and UI animation fixes.

🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰

That’s all for now! Looking ahead, we're preparing another update focused on phasing out more Elemental cards. That tribe never quite got the love they deserved, and it's time to shift our focus deeper into the Demon family, especially what's lurking in the 3rd Hell: [b]Thul[/b].

Upcoming changes will also affect many cards in the Corruption and Destruction domains:
[list]
[*] Destruction Demons will be slightly redesigned to better reflect their chaotic nature.
[*] Corruption Demons will begin to unleash their... tempting powers.
[/list]

Stay tuned. Stay evil. 😈

notes.title: Patch Notes EA_v0.63 - The Cold before the Storm.
notes.content:
Greetings, Aspiring Dark Mages!

I’ve added some cool updates to Frost—literally. Things are a bit tougher, a lot more immersive, and way more fun as you climb the ranks of icy badassery. Go check below what’s new!

[b]⚖️ GAME BALANCE ⚖️[/b]

-- Keen-Eye Starter Deck: The entire deck has been revamped! Every single card has been rebalanced or redesigned. Test it out and discover how the new changes play out!

- Ice Shards: Now generates 1 Cold every 6 TUs for a total duration of 30 TUs. Cold will no longer decrease at the end of Ice Shards life cycle.

- Ice Storm: The effects of this spell have been significantly overhauled and now scale better with Cold! 

Each Villager will suffer the following effects every 5 TUs if Cold reaches these thresholds:

Cold 40+: Each Villager receives Slow 1.

Cold 60+: Each Villager receives Slow 2 and -1 Attack Damage.

Cold 80+: Each Villager receives Slow 3, -1 Attack Damage, and takes 2 Damage.

- Slow Debuff: Enemies affected by Slow will now retain a minimum speed of 1. This keeps Slow strategies viable, while making them slightly less dominant.

[b]🃏 CARDS BALANCE 🃏[/b]

- Blizzard: no longer generates Cold based on Ice Shards. Instead, it deals 1 Damage to each Villager for each Ice Shard in play. Additionally, Blizzard now refreshes the duration of each Ice Shard on the battlefield! To balance this powerful effect, the cost has been increased to 6 TUs.

- Ostearch Maiden/Handmaid: The Health of this minion has been slightly increased.

- Frost Sword: The Damage boost is now limited to +5.

[b]🐛 BUGS 🐛[/b]

- Fixed incorrect Experience values when player reaches Level 24.

-Fixed a bug on "Corrupted Preciousss" card when cast with 2+ Gold Nuggets on the Battlefield.

🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰

The Frost experience might be nearly complete, but there's still plenty on the horizon! I'm getting closer to rolling out those long-promised features, and here's a sneak peek at what's coming:

- New game modes
- The Malice/Virtue System – the ultimate challenge for those brave enough to challenge Glowing Skull runs.
- New vendors to discover and deal with
- More Limited Edition cards, including some all-new Limited Edition minions
- Standalone decks – a set of compact Starter decks with unique mechanics outside the main 4 Domains

Big things are on the way—stay tuned, and of course... stay evil. 😈

notes.title: Patch Notes EA_v0.63 - Bigger on the inside!
notes.content:
Hello Aspiring Dark Mages!

This new patch is a weird one... it was supposed to be a routinary patch to fix the usual small bugs that arise here and there and it slowly became a game-changer! You'll notice a longer than usual list of changes and updates! Some core mechanics are impacted aswell, hopefully for the best!

Without further ado, here is the list of what is new in game!

[b]🛠️ NEW CONTENT 🛠️[/b]
- Rulebook: the Rules for the game can now be conveniently accessed both from the Main Menu and in the Shop, in case you wish to review some mechanics of the game before purchasing new cards or upgrades...
- Miracles: the new Miracles introduced with the big Frost game update were... Boring? Bad? Wards were particularly nasty, as they were either useless or devastating, based on your deck build. They were just un-funny, hence I redesigned almost each of the "Rune" Miracles. Just check the Library to see how those updated Miracles work!
- Flesh Cult Deck: this deck received a Major update! The card Spring Cleaning/Make Room was deemed very powerful. Now it is an Unleash card that launches Corpses on the Battlefield at a controlled rate, rather than being both an awesome Corpse generator and a very reliable defensive tool. The Flesh Collector is now a Sadistic Butcher! To compensate the reduced Corpse generation, now this updated minion has a Loop ability that self-inflicts damage to create Corpses. The old healing ability still stands so...
- Ratageddon Deck: also the Rats of Doom received a big update of one of their least favourite card: Gnawing Critters is now an Unleash card that transform Corpses into Rats whenever you play a "Rat" card.

[b]⚖️ GAME BALANCE ⚖️[/b]
- Game Difficulty & Miracles: this is partially a retrace of a former change, but I feel it is needed. The rate at which Miracles are added to deck changed for 0 and 1 Skull runs. Now at 0 Skulls players will receive a single Miracle from Rounds 10 to 15. In 1 Skull runs Miracles will be added at Rounds 5, 10 and 15, making a total of 3 Miracles for the last round. Higher difficulties Miracle ratios are unaltered.
- Necropotence: significant nerf. Now you will no longer get a Devotion skelly but "just" a Skeleton Crackhead, a fighter unit that is not even considered a Minion. Former version of the Death Pact was objectively overpowered.
- Ice Shards: they now generate 5 Cold upon entering the battlefield (was 6).
- Cold Generation: flat cold generation has been reduced all over the game. Too many small changes to track them, generally cards/minions will add less Cold, generate less shards or card cost received small tweeks.
- Icestorm: damage reduced. Was 1/3/5 for the three tiers of storm intensity, now it is 1/2/3 and applies Slow 1/2/3 aswell.
- Ghoran Profit: mechanic for this hidden skill has been changed. Now when you hit the Oblation action, if you have this skill, you'll also destroy each Gold Nugget on the Battlefield. Then you'll draw a card for every 2 Gold destroyed this way.

[b]🃏 CARDS BALANCE 🃏[/b]
- Ostearch Maiden: mechanic reworked. Now the skeletal lady gained two Warcry abilities: one will summon an Ostearch Despoiler if you have 6 or more cards in hand, the second will summon a Ostearch Despoiler if there are 6 or more cards in the Graveyard.
- Snow Imp: now the imps will destroy the Gold Nugget closest to the Dark Tower.
- March of the Dead: big change! This card was another one clearly too powerful for its rarity and intended gameplay... It has been redesigned completely: now will summon a Spear Skeleton when the player casts a "Skeleton" card (any Minion card having the Skeleton trait) and will summon a Rotten Zombie when the player casts a "Zombie" card (again, any Minion card having the Zombie trait). This change is justified largely by the sheer amount of crazy builds that allowed to beat the game too easily once in possession of two copies of this card! 

[b]🐛 BUGS 🐛[/b]
- Patched Thing: source code was very old and had conflicts with the new Entombed mechanics. 
- Keen-Eye Invoker: the upgraded Stormcaller had an higher than intented Health charateristic (19!!). Now it has 10 Hp as planned.

🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠

Big changes! I want to thank personally user Faust who provided an insane amount of feedback and suggestions (this ahs been an ongoing help since the demo days!!!). If you feel there are broken mechanics that need some attention, please write about it in the game forum of join my Discord for a personal touch! :D

notes.title: Time to freeze the World in The Dark Horde!
notes.content:
Hello, aspiring Dark Mages!

It is finally time to expand the game with the long awaited fourth Domain: Frost! 

The dead city of Imlan has finally opened its gates: which secrets are hidden beneath this frozen landscape? 

Meet the Moon worshipping Keen-Eye tribe, dominate the Ostearch legions and unleash the monstrosities dwelling the ice covered forests unto the enemy!

Here is the list of the content of this patch!

🛠️ NEW CONTENT 🛠️
- Level cap raised to 24, Frost content is progressively unlocked as you level up.
- 5 Frost Starter decks: the first starter deck is unlocked at level 18.
- 52 unlockable cards for Frost domain: new card mechanics are introduced that will alter the way you build your decks.
- Cold/Icestorm/Iceshards mechanics: as Cold raise, a furious storm will torment hapless Villagers!
- Updated UI to include the new Cold meter 
- 2 new unlockable Skills: Icying on the Cake and Rainbow of Hate.
- 1 new unlockable Boon: Permafrost.
- 7 new Miracles
- updated endrun scores:  you will earn higher score for having 3 or 4 domain balanced at the end of a run, if you managed to destroy the Village always during the first Day of Battle or you completed a run without any Enrages from the Village.
- new Achievements
- updated Rulebook: includes rules for the whole Cold/Icestorm new mechanic, the updated rule for how Dark Gems are awarded and how the final score is calculated with a list of all bonuses.
 
⚖️ GAME BALANCE ⚖️
- Death Guard, the tier 5 Death starter deck has been reworked (once again!)
- the Avatar of Death is no longer considered a Minion (can't be sacrificed, can't be killed by The Hamlet Witch, ...). This change iimpacts GREATLY the card "March of the Dead", has the Avatar can no longer be chain-summoned.
- End of Round balance bonus (both Minor, Major or Supreme) requires a deck of 8 cards or more.

🃏 CARDS BALANCE 🃏
- Some cards had their rarity updated: Dancing Monster (now Rare, was Epic), Bone Mastery (now Epic, was Rare), King of the Tribes (now Rare, was Epic), Fire Trap (now Epic, was Rare), Avatar of Evil (now Rare, was Epic), Sheperd of Bearded Hats (now Epic, was Rare).
- Wrathpriest updated: during the Night the guy generates Cold! During the Day he still generates Sacrifice and at a higher rate (3 --> 4)
- King of the Tribe became King of the Tribes, now that a second barbarian tribe joined the frey. The King ability has been completely updated: after an Action generates Sacrifice during the Day and Cold during the Night.
- Crazy Diamond has left the game!
- Tainted Poplar replaced the spot of Crazy Diamond. It has a very similar ability as CD one, but it is clearly a nerf of a once OP card.

🐛 BUGS 🐛
- Loading Time: the Loading time of Rounds has been GREATLY reduced. The game loaded EVERY music track, not just the one used and this caused the longer than necessary loading time...
- Alchemist: now the Alchemist ability correctly deals damage to Minions and no longer damages the Dark Tower. 

🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾

As usual, taking advantage of the Early Access status, please provide feedback should you encounter any bugs or weird behaviours, if you don't like something or in case you have any awesome suggestions for the game! Maybe not evryone is aware of this, but MANY of the features and changes in TDH were suggested by users on my Discord or in the forum so...

The list of content that will be released for the game from now on will mostly revolve around QoL features, cloud saves, leaderboards, graphic updates, new game modes, expanded game lore, game balance and here and there cards that will replace existing ones...

And lastly, a big thank you to all those that by playing the game a providing their opinions helped me greatly in steering the game in the right direction! We are at a point where MANY of the features in the game have been added/changed after one of those inputs and there are many many many more still queued in development!

Matt

notes.title: Patch Notes EA_v0.2
notes.content:
Hello, aspiring Dark Mages!

With this patch there are many new features in the game: a card library, a deck button, a screen to recap your performance! Also 12 new cards, while some others have (temporarily?) left the game, waiting for the right moment to come back! Also, some pesky bugs have been solved, one still tied to the despicable "Immortal Village" of the last month...

Without further ado, here is the list of what is new in game!

[b]🛠️ NEW CONTENT 🛠️[/b]
- 12 new cards! The last remaining cards for Death, Destruction and Corruption domains enter the fray! Each domain received 3 new Rare cards and 1 Epic card. These cards will be unlocked at level 18 and, oh boy, there are some powerful ones to explore! For Death the spotlight goes to the Surviving Vampire who is invulnerable during the Night. Destruction received a new powerful Pyromancy: Fire Trap! If you have trouble dealing with the party of Heroes, this is the card for you! And last but not least, The All-Eater for Corruption will devour anything on its path growing stronger as it crawls its way to the Village!
- Death Guard deck revamped! This tier 5 deck for Death domain has been revamped. Some cars are gone (Shield Skeleton and 2 Minutes to Midnight) but other powerful cards replaced them: Skeletal Captain and Skeletal Deathwish! 
- Run Recap: when victorious in a Deck run, a screen will recap you score, your deck and your upgrades! Time to brag about it with your friends!
- Deck Button: the deck button in a Round is now clickable and will show the cards in the deck (not in draw order ofc!). Now you will know what's left to draw and the odds for drawing the card you are waiting for.
- Card Library! The first version for a Card Library has landed! You can now explore all the cards you have unlocked. Mind that this is just the first version: in the future each card will be interactable and will provide extensive information about rules and lore!

[b]⚖️ GAME BALANCE ⚖️[/b]
- Draft Run tuned: Draft run has been slightly reworked in how the Village grows in power. The goal was to make Rounds 20-25 the highest ones but I'm sure someone will find a way to hit Rounds 30+!
- The Throne button (for those who unlocked it) will be deactivated during Draft Runs, as no Blood Skulls are given in this game mode.
- Scroll windows no longer have any annoying elastic effect and the content is clamped.

[b]🃏 CARDS BALANCE 🃏[/b]
- Some Limited Edition cards received a slight buff in their cost. The effects are unchanged.
- Cursed Bellringer: this Minions received the Defender ability and will from now on remain safely under the tower consistently providing its ability to draw a card when you play a Miracle.
- Shield Skeleton/2 Minuts to Midnight/Zombie Cutthroath have temporarily left the game to give room to more interesting cards.

[b]🐛 BUGS 🐛[/b]
- Rat Emperor: he wisely decided to boost the speep of the Swarms in its command AFTER spawning a Swarm and not the other way around... 
- Miracles will no longer POP if not in hand when timer reach zero.
- Boss name will correctly appear in the Battle Preview.
- Bosses came back! For a while, only the Valkirye and the Ovinomancer were selected as Bosses for a run. Now all bosses are back in the game! (And I shouldn't say this, but it seems like 7 new Bosses will be added to the game in the future... shhhhhh!)

🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾 🏰👨🏻‍🌾🏠👩🏻‍🌾

That's it for now! As usual, please inform me should you find bugs or issues! And as usual, I'm all ears listening to your suggestions, feedback and also ideas for new features for the game! Just join my Discord (button below) or write about your findings/ideas on the forum!

notes.title: The Immortal Village Bug is solved.
notes.content:
Hello aspiring Dark Mages! 

Many might have "noticed" that sometimes and unpredictably the Village became immortal, not allowing the round to be completed. Many found this pretty annoying! How could a Village refuse to submit to might of the armies of Evil???

As per title, the Synod of Dark Mages finally found how to stop this non-sense. 

No more will a Village resist eternally when razed by a legion of undeads!
No more will a Village deflect Pyromancies!
No more will a Village resist an invasion of Plague Rats!
No more!

TL;DR: this patch solves the annoying Immortal Village bug.

Should something bad happen again, please inform me!

notes.title: Patch Notes EA_v0.2
notes.content:
Hello, aspiring Dark Mages! 

For the first time, [b]new content[/b] has arrived for The Dark Horde! Also, I have changed some prices here and there (Mirror's Overseer, I'm talking to you!) and solved a bug that involved the Draft Mode. Finally, newcomers will have an easier way beating the early game as zero Skulls runs will no longer clog the players' decks with those pesky Miracles...
Here comes the list of evrything new in the game!

[b]🛠️ NEW CONTENT 🛠️[/b]

- [b]Blood Throne completely reworked![/b] End game will be completely different now, as Dark Mages who managed to collect 1 or more Blood Skulls will have new opportunities to spend their precious Skulls! In particular, at the cost of 4 Blood Skulls, you can now purchase Limited Edition cards! 
- 9 New Cards: 3 cards for each Domain in the game, with new powerful cards like the Incubus, the Ritual of Fire or the Swallowing Mass! Each Domain has 2 new Uncommon cards and 1 new Rare card.
- Envoys of Ghor deck [Destruction Tier 5]: completely reworked! Mischievous Imps and Corpse Demon cards now have new mechanics. 
- Twisted Forest deck: cards/characters were reskiinned to have a cohesive theme. [same as above.]
- Rats now have the Rat race keyword. While cool to have, this has no impact in any mechanic of the game. Yet! 

[b]⚖️ GAME BALANCE ⚖️[/b]

- [b]Blood Skulls are given at a rate of 1 per Round[/b], up to the maximum Blood Skulls collected.
- Resources are limited to 99 units. Each extra resources collected while at 99 are lost.
- The rate at which the amount of Dark Gems awarded increase with Round number has been slightly decreased.
- [b]Zero Skull runs from now on will have no Miracles[/b] to thwart your run! After all, they will come in full force at every higher difficulty... 
- Goblin Looters steal only 3 Gold when pillaging the Village (was 5).
- The cost to duplicate cards at the Mirror's Overseer is now 7 Heroic Souls (was 5).
- The cost to remove a card from the deck at the Mirror's Overseer is now 5 Heroic Souls (was 3)
- Upgrading a Forge costs 1 Dark Gems less for each rank (a single Forge now requires 16 Dark Gems, was 20).
- Along Envoys of Ghor deck rework, the staple card Blood-Eye Possessed/Vessel has been slightly nerfed, dealing 1 less damage to the Village when the condition is met.
- Restoring 1 lost Health of the Dark Tower now costs 2 Gold and 2 Common Souls (was 3 of each)
- A single Blood Skull restores 4 lost Health (was 2).
- Cards found in any booster (even Limited Edition ones!) can now be rerolled by paying 2 Gold or 2 Common Souls. In case, you can still spend a Dark Gem, if you have one to spare...
- [b]Common Souls collected and on their way to the Dark Tower will be automatically collected[/b] when the Time is up! Goblins will still need to reach the vanishing Dark Tower to unload the Gold... Also, this change does not apply to Heroic Souls: those are collected the hard way. This also means that the Vacuum Cleaner upgrade now only works for Common Souls not being collected, as the others will already be affected by this change.
- Heroic Souls acquired at the Trader in the Necro-Comicon will not be counted for the final score.


[b]🃏 CARDS BALANCE 🃏[/b]

notes.title: EA_v011: Cards Balance, Draw mechanic redesigned and some bugs fixed
notes.content:
Hello, aspiring Dark Mages! After 2 weeks it is time for the first patch that revolves mostly on the balancing of a few selected cards deemed too powerful or too weak/unfit. But there is another important change that noone will probably notice: the Draw system has been redesigned, mostly to avoid conflicts between multiple istances of Card Drawing effects and Miracle discards. No need to go into details, but from now on there won't be issues (hopefully) while Drawing cards like Eternal Knowledge is in you hand. The bug was mostly evident when Iconoclasm was played and the Eternal Knowledge effect triggered aswell. Also the change resolves rare bugs on Miracle's unleash countdown when cards where discarded (The Magician miracle or Iconoclasm).

[h3]CARD BALANCE[/h3]

[b]Farewell to Arms/Tear and Rip[/b]: damage reduced but now if there are 9+/7+ corpses on the battlefield, you draw a card.

[b]Orc Drummer[/b]: now there is a 33% chance to draw a card when any Orc enters the battlefield, including Orc Drummer itself (no longer deals damage to the Village when Orcs die)

[b]Hellgate of Ghor[/b]: damage reduced to 2 from 3 per demon that enters the battlefield.

[b]The Ecstasy of Gold[/b]: unleash countdown reduced to 30 (was 45).

[b]Golden Rain[/b]: Gold Meteors reduced to 10 (was 14).

[b]Fire Wave[/b]: no longer deals damage to Villagers in middle zone, but deals damage to Villagers in the Tower Zone. Also lets you draw 1 card. Damage reduced to 12 for the normal card, 15 for the Upgraded card.

[b]Skitters in the Dark[/b]: unleash countdown incresed to 60 but only 1 Swarm of Rats is summoned when the ability triggers.

[b]Crazy Gravelooter[/b]: minion stats decreased but now he will find Gold inside corpses with 75% chance (was 50%).

[b]Flesh Eater Worms/Necrosis Worms[/b]: copies of the minion will be summoned at doubled speed.

[b]Fire Embrace[/b]: renamed "Burn to Ash".

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]

- As mentioned above, Draw System has been revamped. This will prevent bugs when Card Drawing effects from multiple istances will take place at the same time and prevents Miracles from miscalculating the unleeash countdown after they are discarded (cards like Iconoclasm, Eternal Knowledge and Miracles are greatly affected by this improvement).

- Blackest Lotus: the Dark Gems gained from this epic card will be awarded immediatly without any delay.

- Fixed a bug where Blood Skulls were set to 0 when a run was Continued from the Main Menu.

notes.title: Yet another tiny patch for EA_v0.11
notes.content:

- fixed a conflict at the end of the round when a player had a Mega Goblin in play while in possession of the Vacuum Cleaner upgrade.
- fixed a bug where the upgraded Monstrous Transformation card gave a Rotten Zombie instead

- moved a couple TUs after the start of the Round the Sacrifice gain from Destruction Boon to avoid conflicts with other upgrades  (this is still under investigation as the bug hasn't been replicated yet) 

That is all for now. If you find a bug, or think you've found one, do not esitate to write about it on the forum or Discord server!

notes.title: Patch Notes EA_v0.11
notes.content:
Aspiring Dark Mages, this is the first patch for The Dark Horde! I will list below all the medium/small changes in the game and the fixes to bugs found during its first week. All these were simple changes requested by players. There are a couple things that will require more effort, the Card Library being of top of the Most Request features. It will be there. Just not "soon".

🛠️ [b]NEW FEATURES[/b] 🛠️
- Card Rerolls: the cards found in a booster can now be rerolled at the cost of 1 Dark Gem.
- Pause Button: a button to access pause menus have been added to the Main Menu, the Shop and the Round scenes.
- Miracle Rerolls: now rerolled miracles are saved and not reverted to the original Miracle(s) if you retry the Round.
- Restart Options: now you can Restart a Round anytime from the pause menu. And the option the retry the Round will be offered in the recap screen even if you were victorious, in case you think you can do better.
- Rulebook: the Rulebook now provides information about Devotion mechanic, Sacrifice mechanic and how bonus Dark Gems are awarded.

⚖️ [b]GAME BALANCE[/b] ⚖️
- Action Buttons Upgrade: are now available from level 1 in the shop.
- Miracle Progression: the rule that randomize Miracles has changed. Now at level 4 and level 8 the most complex Miracles will be secretly unlocked for randomization. Basically this means that new player will not find complex Miracles like High Priestess, The Moon, The Sun or The Hanged Man.
- Raze and Swiftness bonus increased: now you will gain more Dark Gems at higher Rounds if you manage to destroy the Village and when you do that in the very first day of a Round.
- Orcish Barrage: the Orc Archers will now spawn after 8 TUs rather than 4.

📖 [b]GAME READABILITY[/b] 📖
- Warnings Text: the size of the Warning Messages have been increased, mostly to accomodate Steamdeck players.
- Boon Tooltip: now you can mouse over Boon upgrades you purchased to have the information about their effect.
- Boss Preview: at the beginning of Rounds 9 and 15 of a Deck run you will receive the information of which boss you are going to face.

🖼️ [b]ART[/b] 🖼️
- New Time Unit icon: the icon for Time Units have changed.
- New Domain Boosters Cost icon: a small "+" in the icon should now make it clear that boosters cost 3 gold and 3 common souls.

🐛 [b]BUGS[/b] 🐛
- Iconoclasm: solved a bug that caused discarded Miracles to calculate the unleash countdown incorrectly.
- Slow Motion: fixed a bug that made time run inconsistently in some occasions at the end of a Round.
- Chosen Harbinger: fixed the spawn point of its magic missiles.
- Blood Skulls: the information about how many Blood Skulls you collected will be correctly shown in the Main Manu.
- Overlapping Loading in Menu: you can no longer go back to the Files Selection Menu and launch a run at the same time if you are quick enough.
- Minor typos: typos have been fixed here and there (Titan on Attack no longer has Stun, the Fear ability tooltip is fixed, ...)

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Early Acces (probably) ready and Roadmap for future content!
notes.content:
Hello, Aspiring Dark Mages!

This is it. The 9th of September the game will be live and you will finally have access to the game in its... Early Access. Ehm.

I think I have assembled evrything I had planned for the Early access release of The Dark Horde! As usual I invite you to join my Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/Jxad2TfYYx]HERE[/url]: I'd love to hear your feedback or your suggestions/ideas for The Dark Horde! Actually, many things for the game changed after some awesome Demo-Players gave me their opinions on various topics! As the solo developer behind this project, I need those feedbacks like I need air!

Many things have changed a bit from what you've seen (or you are seeing) in the demo: some cards have been nerfed, some received a boost, some UI changes. Not a big deal, the game core is the same!

At least now I have a definitive list of what will be in the Early Access version:

[b]Two game modes: [/b]

Deck and Draft. In Deck mode you play with an unlocked premade deck of your choice. Draft mode is basically an endless mode where you decide how you'll begin the run.

[b]Cards: [/b]

- 135 of three Domains (Death, Destruction, Corruption)
- 60 premium cards, unlocked for completing Deck runs.
- 22 Miracle cards
- 15 unlockable premade decks, each consisting of 3 common cards and an uncommon card

[b]Progression:[/b]

- 18 experience levels
- 6 levels of difficulty for each premade deck
- with each level you will unlock cards and in the Shop you will have access to more options that will dramatically alter gameplay as you progress. The Mirror's Overseer, The Trainer, The Boon Master and The Collector will be found in the Necro-Comicon!

[b]Heroes:[/b]
- 16 heroes (4 tanks, 4 dps, 4 casters, 4 healers)
- 4 Mid Run Bosses (The Valkyrie, The Black Knight, The Hamlet Witch, The Oz-Born Gang)
- 4 End Run Bosses (The Angel of Salvation, The Leper Messiah, The Ovinomancer, The Sunfire Knight)

I can't give a number for the possible viable strategies that will make you win a run. The combinations and synergies of each mechanic in the game are just too many...

And now, as The Dark Horde will release in Early. Access, it means that there is still a lot to develop... Here is a brief list of the content that I will be add to the game (free of charge):

- 10 Death cards
- 10 Destruction cards
- 10 Corruption cards
- Graphic Updates for the Battlegrounds
- Graphic Updates for the Shop and the Necro-Comicon
- Frost cards! A minimum of 30 new cards with new mechanics and interactions!
- Frost Miracles. Special Miracles that will behave slighly different from the current Miracles you [don't] love.
- Game Lore
- Card Library: detailed descriptions of each card in the game
- Bestiary: a description of each Minion and each Villager in the game 
- Leaderboards
- Challenges! Difficult tasks only the mightiest Dark Mage can complete!
- New Vendors at the Necro-Comicon.
- Extra Mid Bosses / Final Bosses
- Customization for the aspect of your Dark Mage and for the Dark Tower. 
- New Game Mode: Time Run
- Alpha Card Images library
- General improvements to menus in the various sections of the game

Well, that's it, I guess. See you in a month!

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Something new and another demo update
notes.content:
Hello Dark Mages!

This update is necessary for a couple of reasons. First, I have updated the demo, again! Some of my most awesome Dark Horde lovers pointed out some aspected about the new Miracles Reroll feature introduced with the last Demo patch. So I had to fix that, even just for the demo! While I was at it, I also updated some other things you might notice. So, here is the list of what is new with this new Demo update:

- Miracles are now saved! This means that if you reroll the Miracles and then retry the level, the initial pool of Miracles will be the same (and the Dark Gem used for the Reroll will be lost). Avoiding those pesky Miracles you hate to draft won't be that easy!
- Fixed a configuration bug where Goblin Looters triggered events for Minions. Goblin Looters are worthless, they don't deserve to be considered Minions.
- Fixed the count of cards when Miracles are added to the deck.
- Added a fancy Yellow glow for Rare cards! (Also added a Purple glow for Epic cards aswell, but those are not available yet...)

Now that the Demo is sorted out, let's see what I recently added for the actual game in Early Access:

- the last remaining basic feature, card removal, has been added for a vendor in the Necro Comicon festival. At the cost of 3 Heroic Souls you will be able to permanently remove 1 of the 4 cards that have been part of your deck the longest. This feature has been added to the Mirror Overseer vendor, that you can unlock once you reach level 8. This vendor has also the wonderful ability to duplicate a card already in your deck for the modest price of 5 Heroic Souls...
- I balanced some cards you haven't seen yet. I'm sure there will be more unbalanced cards at Release, but that's what Early Access is there for: receiving feedback!
- I fixed a SERIOUS bug that involved the Endless Mode of the game. 

I think that what will be in the first Early Access release is pratically ready for publishing to be honest! But let's wait for summer to end instead of rushing things... after all, Fall is a better season to lay waste on enemy villages...

notes.title: DEVLOG #1 - Road to Early Access
notes.content:
Hi! Been a long time since the last update and I new feel it is the right time to recap how development is going!

Steam Next Fest has been great and more people than I expected played the Demo. The Dark Horde gained almost twice the wishlists that I set as minimum goal to be happy about the event itself. Met also some players that were absolutely blown away by the demo and have been sharing their daily progress in Discord (even designing strategies I've never thought of...).

What is still missing for The Dark Horde v1.0?

To be honest the EA version is almost complete but the feedback I received during SNF made me reconsider various things:
- Time Units left before Time Up are now explicit. Previously you had to evaluate the Sun and Moon position only.
- The UI now shows the number of Gold/Souls/Corpses on the Battleground the help the player evaluate decisions.
- the card "Lust for Gold" (and its upgraded version Grab Riches) have been changed by popular demand and the Gold will not be thrown behind the tower
- I will had a screen to inform the player of which Miracles are being added each round with an options to pay [still to be decided] to reroll the Miracles hoping to find more forgiving ones...
- I will add an option to REMOVE cards from the deck; also this request came from various players so I simply cannot ignore it. My initial idea was that players were meant to deal with what they had, but clearly removing cards is something deckbuilder lovers like too much...
- I solved all the small/big bugs found during SNF

So, what will there be in the game on release?
- 15 premade decks, 5 per domain (Death, Destruction, Corruption)
- Endless Draft mode
- 132+ cards
- 60 reward cards
- 21 Miracle cards
- 6 level of difficulty for each deck
- 4 Mid Bosses (on Deck Run round 9)
- 4 Final Bosses (on Deck Run round 15)

What will be added after Early Access to the game? 
- 30+ Death/Destruction/Corruption cards
- New Domain: Frost cards!
- Compendium with information about cards, minion, villagers, lore
- Leaderboard (I want to balance the game a bit first, then we can talk about score :D)
- Extra Mid Bosses / Final Bosses 

The Dark Horde will be released end of September, if in the meanwhile you want to hang out with me, or if you have cool ideas or anything to report, join my discord server [url=https://discord.gg/Jxad2TfYYx]HERE[/url] !

notes.title: The Orcs situation...
notes.content:
Hello!

Today I present a major update for the demo of The Dark Horde! 

NEW RANK 1 DESTRUCTION DECK
This update is much needed for a simple reason: players who started the game playing the Orc Warlord deck clearly felt the game being... dumb? If you already played the Orcs starter deck maybe you already know the reason: Orcs are WAY TOO powerful! So powerful you can simply play an Orc Brawler and wipe out any resistance for the first 3-4 rounds of battle or even more. If your played the Orcs for your first game of The Dark Horde the game felt... stupid! The thing with the Orcs is that you have an easy time destroying the enemy village but you struggle looting resources since your warriors stomp on any easy prey. This aspect is simply not clear for a newcomer, while you immediatly feel the lack of resources if you already experienced the game playing the Zombie starter deck or the Graverobber deck. 

So I decided to assign the Orc Warlord deck to Destruction rank 3 and now we have the Blood-Eyed starter deck in its place for the Destruction domain as rank 1!

Who are those Blood-Eye barbarians? While less powerful than the Orcs they replaced, those fierce marauders draw their power from the Sun: every Blood-Eye tribe member has a different ability with the DAY keyword. This means that their ability triggers only if it is daytime. Let's see which cards are included in the Blood-Eyed starter deck.

1) Blood-Eye Plunderer: a warrior with an ability that let you gain Sacrifice if you activate any Action button.
2) Blood-Eye Blacksmith: the cleric of the tribe. If you activate any Action button during the day, all you WARRIORS gain +2 damage on their attacks!
3) Viking Funeral: a pyromancy that applies BURN to each peasant on the battlefield (only PEASANTS, not Heroes or Big Wigs...)
4) Blood-Eye Plainstrider: a ranged warrior that increase its attack damage when you play an Action during the day. Couple it with the Blood-Eye Blacksmith an you will have a ranged killer on the Battlefield!

I hope you enjoy the new starter deck! If you miss the ORcs, they will make their return in Early Access, and they will be available again when you hit level 7!

I also changed the availability for some cards in the uncommon/rare/epic ranks. Mainly because with the Orcs starter deck out, there was little room left for the Orc Drummer, the Orc Motivator, the Orc King and the Wild Pillage! Feel free to spot what was added new... and if you see something missing, just wait for the Early Access :D

DEMO SHOP UPDATE:
I changed the upgrades available in the demo. The Forges are no longer available in the demo but now you'll have access to the Action Upgrades, which feel more interesting for the demo. The Icons for Death/Destruction/Corruption boosters have changed and should more clearly reflect the effect of adding a Death/Destruction/Corruption to your deck.

That's all for now, see you on the Battlefields!
Matt
